scope: Independent read-only implementation review and six bounded temporary-root probes. No implementation/provider edits or remote operations by this reviewer.

preservedPositiveChanges.finding: A compressed segment short write now refuses before publishing a segment or retiring the original sealing file.
preservedPositiveChanges.composition: Prior multi-block row writer and reader retained; imported StoreError and exact compressed.length return check composed into the writer.

preservedPositiveChanges.finding: Seven new durability cases are retained: zero-byte and one-byte compressed segment writes; four ordinary-head failure stages alongside strict cases; one large ordinary-head prefix/ENOSPC failure.
preservedPositiveChanges.composition: Strict-publication tests are byte-exact concurrent main. Sealed-log tests differ only by explicit seal:false in the helper, necessary under preserved automatic sealing.

preservedPositiveChanges.finding: Ordinary head runtime already used the same file-owner complete atomic writer at both source heads; the added tests improve coverage.
preservedPositiveChanges.composition: Retained concurrent-main head explanation and its precise store-spec replacement sentence.

removedContractsRestored.contract: Incremental record reading and change notification
removedContractsRestored.details: appended with per-bucket position/inode and reset on shrink/replacement/disappearance; recordsChangeWitness and new-put directory mtime; original public exports.

removedContractsRestored.contract: SEAVT carrier admission and bounded append
removedContractsRestored.details: SEAVT row/budget exports; 1 MiB row allowance; maxBytes, guard, seal and boolean append return; raw and sealed multi-block line reading; automatic sealing. Unchanged row/compaction modules still import the removed constants.
Real Gregorian calendar dates and exact-fraction utcFilingInstant remain required by unchanged seavt-carrier. Exact time comparison itself was not redesigned.

removedContractsRestored.contract: Peer causal custody and head convergence
removedContractsRestored.details: Identity verification before retention, missing/malformed cause refusal, second-read revalidation and actual cause presence, plus closure-only transitions on an unchanged frontier. Valid ordinary cross-type traversal succeeds on both old and regressed sources; its completeness and identity protections were removed.
Validated positive safe integer maxBytes forwarded to strict JSON admission; both source/canonical limits and all other original guards retained.
Formula-constant bucket paths and bounded exact-line digest verdict cache restored; no new index or runtime authority added. No performance benchmark was run in this review.

removedContractsRestored.contract: Earlier-layout refusal distinguishes a directory from a note
removedContractsRestored.details: Original directory check restored; a regular data/journals note is not treated as a legacy store.
All six removed store cases restored alongside all seven concurrent durability additions.

unchangedFrontierClosure.prior: closed:true transported with zero new records

baselineNativeEvidence.role: Read from separately executed native baseline, not counted as independent probes.

decision: The combined source retains the established logging contracts and the useful concurrent short-write fix. Accepted for the separate full-native and packed owner qualification gates.
limits: This is source-composition evidence, not registry issuance or live host adoption.
Independent probes are separate from the owner native and packaged suites.
Atomic head replacement and uncertain post-publication results retain their original contract; no combined transaction is claimed.
